                     Pending Litigation - Friends of Oceano Dunes v. San Luis Obispo Air Pollution
                     Control District, et al., San Luis Obispo Superior Court Case Number 22CV-0231.
                     Pursuant to California Government Code § 11126(e)(1) and (e)(2)(A), the
                     Commission will hold a closed session at its meeting on August 06, 2026 in Kings

                     regarding the pending litigation of Friends of Oceano Dunes v. San Luis Obispo Air

Pollution Control District, et al. as discussion in open session concerning the
       litigation would prejudice the position of the Commission in the litigation.
XIV.   ADJOURNMENT




                                                                                         2

(1) AGENDA PROCEDURE
    Unless the agenda is revised by the Chair or by a vote of the Commission, the Commission will proceed through
    the agenda in order until the agenda is completed.

(2) LUNCH
    The Commission will take a lunch recess at the Chair’s discretion.

(3) PUBLIC COMMENT
    a. Speaker Time Limit: The Chair of the Commission has the authority to set and adjust the time limits
       for public comments during meetings. This includes the ability to reduce the allotted time for individual
       speakers or the overall public comment period, as deemed necessary to ensure the efficient conduct of the
       meeting.
    b. Agenda Items: The chair will entertain public comment as the Commission takes up agenda items.
       Comments will be limited to three (3) minutes. Individuals that intend to comment on agenda items should
       use the “raise hand” feature on Zoom or fill out the green “Public Comment - Agenda Items” form and
       submit it to the Commission’s recording secretary.
    c. Non-Agenda Items: Individuals that intend to address the Commission on non-agenda items during the
       public comment period should use the “raise hand” feature on Zoom or fill out the blue “Public Comment –
       Non-Agenda Items” form and submit it to the commission’s recording secretary.
    d. Written Material(s): Members of the public presenting written or graphic materials as part of their public
       comments to the Commission are required to submit the material(s) to Vicki Perez at
       Vicki.Perez@parks.ca.gov no later than June 10, 2026.
    e. Visual Aid(s): Members of the public presenting visual aids (projected media) as part of their public
       comments to the Commission are requested to submit the material(s) to Vicki.Perez@parks.ca.gov no later
       than July 31, 2026. The Commission and the Division are unable to accept files larger than 25MB. The
       Division reserves the right to decline to show photographs that violate personal privacy (photos without a
       release from the person/people shown in the photograph) or other valid reason in the opinion of the Division
       and its legal counsel.

(4) CLOSED SESSION
    Closed session may be called to discuss pending and/or potential litigation as permitted by Government Code
    section 11126 et seq. Conference with legal counsel to confer with and receive advice regarding pending
    litigation when discussion in open session would prejudice the position of the Commission. [Gov. Code §
    11126(e)(1) & (e)(2)(A)]. The closed session is not open to the public. Commissioners will adjourn to an adjacent
    room for the closed session, and at the conclusion of the closed session the Commission will reconvene in open
    session to provide an account of any reportable events as required.

(5) LIVE WEBCAST
    A live webcast of this meeting can be found at CAL-SPAN.
